 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. The Vancouver Canucks begin a road back-to-back on Sunday as they battle the Vegas Golden Knights . Vancouver is looking to end a seven-game losing streak and pick up its first win in November. Here are the lineup notes for November 15, 2026.
 Manny Malhotra appears to be making some changes to his forward lines. Based on morning skate, Jonathan Lekkerimäki will be playing with Elias Pettersson and Jake DeBrusk while Brock Boeser moves to a line with Filip Chytil and Paul Cotter. The Canucks also made two roster moves over the past 24 hours, with Nikita Tolopilo being called up while Jacob Quillan was assigned to the Abbotsford Canucks .
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement As for the projected starting goaltender, that would be Leevi Meriläinen. While Kevin Lankinen was seen in the starter's net, the 24-year-old was the first goaltender off the ice, according to Sportsnet's Dan Murphy . This season, Meriläinen is 2-9-1 and has started each of the last four games.
